description: This file contains unit tests for the MacGatewayChatTransport module, focusing on mapping various event types to transport events, validating correct behavior for health, tick, chat, and unknown events, as well as sequence gaps.

classes.name: MacGatewayChatTransportMappingTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the mapping of different event types in the MacGatewayChatTransport module.

methods.name: `snapshot maps to health`
methods.description: Tests that a snapshot event is correctly mapped to a health transport event.

methods.name: `health event maps to health`
methods.description: Verifies that a health event is correctly mapped to a health transport event.

methods.name: `tick event maps to tick`
methods.description: Checks that a tick event is correctly identified as a tick transport event.

methods.name: `chat event maps to chat`
methods.description: Ensures that a chat event is correctly mapped to a chat transport event with the expected properties.

methods.name: `unknown event maps to nil`
methods.description: Tests that an unknown event type results in a nil mapping, indicating unhandled event types.

methods.name: `seq gap maps to seq gap`
methods.description: Verifies that sequence gap events are correctly identified as sequence gaps.
